name: kirsch_plate
source: Kirsch plate with circular hole, uniaxial tension sigma0 = F/(w*t) = 2400/240 = 10 MPa. Stress concentration Kt=3 at the hole edge (theta=90deg): sigma_xx(r) at the top of the hole; ref is the first-cell value at r~10.5-11 (Kirsch sigma_theta = sigma0/2*(1+a^2/r^2+1+3a^4/r^4) -> ~23.5), not the 30 MPa boundary peak — staircased hole + cell-centre sampling.
notes: Far-field checks sit on the diagonal (25,25) and top-centre (0,28) — points on the y=0 ray near the loaded face see spurious transverse stress from the force_n spread + hole shadow (Saint-Venant end layer) and are not usable as a uniaxial reference.
